claims.statement: An advertisement gave Tom Allen's place as 619 Market Street, St. Louis, with a free concert every evening.
claims.excerpt: 619 Market street. Free concert every evening. Best of singers only engaged.

claims.statement: Tom Allen styled himself retired champion pugilist of the world.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen, retired champion pugilist of the wworld, 619 Market street.

notes: Only a saloon advertisement. The irrigation and racing items are not about Allen.
